summary: document view flags a possibly-incomplete result when legals or parties reach the 200-row fetch cap instead of silently truncating.
reason: The legals and parties fetches used a hard-coded $limit of 200 with no truncation signal; large condo/portfolio recordings exceed it and produced a silently incomplete documentView. Named the cap (documentFetchLimit) and set a Note (surfaced in JSON and human output) when either slice reaches it.
